answer_1.quote: We further narrow down the retrieved passages by applying an additional passage-wise attention based on more expressive representations from the joint encoding of query and passages... The representations of the final set of passages are then encoded by transformer encoders for deeper representations that are fused in the decoder to generate the answers.

answer_2.quote: Our best scores improve EM scores by 0.7 points on both NQ and TQA respectively over the previously best performing model of the same size, EMDR 2.
